2608.14389.title: GBU-Palm: A Multimodal Video Dataset and Benchmark for Palm Presentation Attack Detection
2608.14389.paper_summary: Existing palm presentation attack detection (PAD) datasets are often limited by static imagery, restricted acquisition conditions, or insufficient multimodal video data, hindering systematic evaluation across environments, modalities, and attack types. We present GBU-Palm, a large-scale multimodal video dataset and benchmark containing 21,326 videos from 105 subjects and 210 palms across six acquisition environments, including bona fide, Print, and Replay presentations, with 6,310 synchronized RGB-NIR samples. We construct leakage-controlled protocols that separate palm identity and attack lineage and benchmark four representative video architectures under environment-matched and held-out-environment settings. Results reveal substantial architecture-dependent degradation under environmental shift and show that RGB-NIR fusion does not consistently outperform RGB-only input. We further analyze model behavior through true accept (TA), true reject (TR), false accept (FA), and false reject (FR) decomposition, spectral masking, temporal-order intervention, and frozen-backbone NIR probing, revealing distinct failure patterns and evidence utilization across architectures. GBU-Palm provides a unified and challenging benchmark for developing and evaluating robust multimodal palm PAD methods under cross-environment conditions.
2608.14389.paper_summary_zh: 現有的掌紋呈現攻擊檢測（PAD）數據集通常受到靜態影像、限制的獲取條件或不足的多模態視頻數據的限制，這妨礙了在不同環境、模態和攻擊類型之間的系統評估。<lb/>我們提出了GBU-Palm，一個大規模的多模態視頻數據集和基準，包含來自105個受試者和210個掌紋的21,326個視頻，涵蓋六個獲取環境，包括真實、打印和重播呈現，並有6,310個同步的RGB-NIR樣本。<lb/>我們構建了控制洩漏的協議，將掌紋身份和攻擊來源分開，並在環境匹配和保留環境設置下基準測試四種代表性視頻架構。<lb/>結果顯示，在環境變化下，架構依賴性降級顯著，並且RGB-NIR融合並不總是優於僅使用RGB的輸入。<lb/>我們進一步通過真接受（TA）、真拒絕（TR）、假接受（FA）和假拒絕（FR）分解、光譜遮罩、時間順序干預和凍結骨幹NIR探測來分析模型行為，揭示了不同架構之間的明顯失敗模式和證據利用。<lb/>GBU-Palm提供了一個統一且具有挑戰性的基準，用於在跨環境條件下開發和評估穩健的多模態掌紋PAD方法。
